contract.task_clause:
You’ve made a scientific theory that there is an attractive force between all objects. When will your theory be proven to be correct?
Option A: The first time you drop a bowling ball and it falls to the ground proving your hypothesis.
Option B: After you’ve repeated your experiment many times.
Option C: You can never prove your theory to be correct only “yet to be proven wrong”.
Option D: When you and many others have tested the hypothesis.
